description: This source file defines a Jetpack Compose UI for an Android app's settings sheet, including device info, media permissions, notification controls, data access, location, and preferences. It interacts with various system permissions and services to manage app settings dynamically.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Represents an installed application with label, package name, and system app flag.

methods.name: queryInstalledApps
methods.description: Queries and returns a list of installed applications that can be launched or are relevant for notification listening, sorted by label.

methods.name: resolveNotificationCandidatePackages
methods.description: Resolves and returns a set of package names for notification forwarding, combining configured, launcher, and recent packages while excluding the app's own package.

methods.name: settingsTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for text fields in the settings UI.

methods.name: Modifier.settingsRowModifier
methods.description: Defines a common styling modifier for settings rows.

methods.name: settingsPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Defines button colors for primary action buttons in settings.

methods.name: settingsDangerButtonColors
methods.description: Defines button colors for danger actions in settings.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Launches the app's settings page in system settings.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens notification listener settings, falling back to app settings if unavailable.

methods.name: hasNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks if notification posting permission is granted (Android 13+).

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener access is enabled for the app.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Determines if the device has motion sensors for activity tracking.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the Assistant role is available on the device.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleHeld
methods.description: Checks if the app holds the Assistant role.
